install:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 -m pip install cursor-sdk pytest openpyxl
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain leanprover/lean4:stable
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.elan/bin/lean" /usr/local/bin/lean
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.elan/bin/elan" /usr/local/bin/elan
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.elan/bin/lake" /usr/local/bin/lake
lean --version
